notes: Introduces reusable section heroes on Firearms and Ammunition.
Rebrands the application UI to AIMS — Arsenal Inventory Management System while retaining existing repository and infrastructure names.
Adds a new default AIMS logo and ammunition-specific hero artwork.
Adds firearm thumbnails and quick Edit, Duplicate, and Details actions to the Firearms table view.
Keeps existing filters, guided firearm setup, reserve status, and card/table workflows intact.
